purpose: Provenance for the regenerated data/models/model_v2_results.json. Records the Script 20 LODO output against the corrected ESM-2 cache produced by scripts/regenerate_esm2_cache_v2.py. Partial closure of audit Finding 2 — the Schistosomiasis arm is not recomputable in this PR because its input selectivity CSV was never committed to git.
missing_input_note: Neither file was ever committed to git. The original LODO numbers in the preprint and in model_v2_results.OLD.json were computed against these files on the curator's working machine in February-April 2026. They are not recoverable from committed data. See Finding 9 in the audit followup PR.

supersedes.explanation: Previous values were computed against an esm2_embeddings_v2.npz cache with two mis-mapped accessions (O00444 keyed as SmHDAC8 = human PLK4; P07711 keyed as HsCatB = human cathepsin L) and with SmDHODH (G4VFD7) missing entirely. Three of six pair-level protein features were therefore zero vectors at LODO time, and Script 20 assigned 0.000 importance to the protein-feature block. PR #17 corrected the UniProt mappings; this PR regenerated the ESM-2 cache against the corrected sequences. The Schistosomiasis arm is not recomputable here because its input selectivity CSV is not in git.

new_results.lodo_Schistosomiasis_explanation: Not computed. Input file data/processed/kira_selectivity_analysis.csv is missing from disk and was never committed to git history.

delta.lodo_Schistosomiasis_auroc: not comparable — Schistosomiasis not loaded in the new run (missing input CSV)
delta.narrative: Leishmaniasis LODO essentially unchanged (delta < 0.001). Trypanosomiasis LODO moved up by 0.026. The most meaningful change is in feature-group importance: the protein-feature block went from exactly 0.000 to 0.070 (7.0%) — the signal the cache fix is designed to recover. With the old contaminated cache, three of six pair-level protein features were zero vectors, so the gradient-boosted model assigned 0% weight to the protein side. CV AUROC and baseline shifted because Schistosomiasis was not in the training set this time (n=218 vs old n=309).
